parameters.jsonOutput:
={{
  {
    ...$json,
    source: 'mastodon.social',
    author: String(
      $json.account?.display_name ||
      $json.account?.username ||
      $json.username ||
      'unknown'
    ).trim(),
    text: String(
      $json.text ||
      $json.content ||
      $json.pleroma?.content?.['text/plain'] ||
      ''
    ),
    tags: Array.isArray($json.tags)
      ? $json.tags.map(tag =>
          typeof tag === 'string' ? tag : tag?.name
        ).filter(Boolean)
      : [],
    media_urls: Array.isArray($json.media_attachments)
      ? $json.media_attachments
          .map(media => media?.url)
          .filter(Boolean)
      : []
  }
}}
